LPN or RN – Day Shift, Monday–Friday Employer: Advantage Nursing Services
Location: Bernie, MO
Type: Flexible (Full-time, Part-time, PRN)
A family-owned company offering weekly pay , flexible scheduling , and comprehensive benefits . You’ll provide one-on-one patient care with full training and 24/7 support. Great fit for nurses who want steady hours and a supportive team.
Travel Physical Therapist – $2,471/week Employer: CrossMed Healthcare Staffing
Location: Dexter, MO
Type: Travel/Contract (13 weeks)
Earn $2,471 per week while working 40 hours in an acute care setting. Includes housing options , medical benefits , and continuing education . Ideal for therapists who love variety and travel.
Urgent Care Physician Employer: Fairview Hospital / Cleveland Clinic
Location: Dexter, MO
Type: Full-time
Provide high-quality care for patients with acute illnesses and minor injuries. Offers competitive pay , health insurance , and retirement plans . Perfect for physicians seeking a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
If you or someone you know is looking for a healthcare role in Stoddard County, now’s a great time to apply and grow your career locally.
